verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is an online legal and business-formation service, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows only an llms.txt crawler-guidance file and an AI meeting-minutes feature, neither of which is an MCP-client capability, so nothing flips the axis to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
